text:
Nia (Partnerships): Quick sync: AtlasCloud marketplace launch + joint GTM. Need final owners and a fallback plan.
Omar (GTM): I'll manage press outreach and embargo. Prefer target public date June 2.
AtlasCloud - Partner: June 2 works. We need marketplace listing visible by June 1 for search indexing.
Bea (Marketing): I'll own landing + paid creative. Can we confirm hero message? Suggest: 'Scale inference on AtlasCloud with Redwood'.
Ravi (Product): Agree on hero. Product will provide integration blueprint and two short how-tos by May 28.
Sofia (Engineering): For marketplace validation we need: final image tag, billing SKU, and staging credentials by May 25 to run tests May 26-27.
Nia (Partnerships): Partners will upload logos and legal-approved co-marketing guidelines by May 24. AtlasCloud?
AtlasCloud - Partner: We'll upload SVG logos and screenshot pack by May 23. Legal approved co-brand template attached via drive.
Omar (GTM): Embargo owner = me. Bea, can you deliver PR draft by May 26?
Bea (Marketing): Yes. I'll post draft to #marketing-drafts and tag legal. Need partner quote + product quote.
Ravi (Product): Product quote: 'Redwood + AtlasCloud brings predictable latency and simplified ops for enterprise LLMs.'
AtlasCloud - Partner: Partner quote: 'AtlasCloud and Redwood help customers deploy production-grade LLMs with cloud-native control.'
Sofia (Engineering): Also request UTM scheme: utm_source=atlascloud, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=atlas_redwood_launch. Add partner_sku param.
Omar (GTM): Noted. Use partner_sku for attribution.
Nia (Partnerships): Owners recap: press/embargo - Omar (May 26); PR - Bea (May 26); product docs - Ravi (May 28); engineering tests - Sofia (run May 26-27); partner assets - AtlasCloud (May 23).
notif-bot: Reminder scheduled: 'AtlasCloud launch test window' on 2026-05-26 09:00 UTC.
Bea (Marketing): Paid budget? Partnerships, can you confirm contribution?
Nia (Partnerships): AtlasCloud committed $7k; we have $3k discretionary. Split?
Omar (GTM): Recommend $6k paid + $4k agency.
AtlasCloud - Partner: Fine. We'll coordinate audiences (devtools, platform eng).
Sofia (Engineering): Contingency: if marketplace listing is delayed, we'll soft-launch partner blog + disable press. Keep me posted on any listing errors.
Nia (Partnerships): Good. I'll run daily 10-min sync in this thread starting May 24. Post blockers ASAP. :white_check_mark:
